learning_objective: 🎯 Master the fascinating life cycle of angiosperms! Understand how beautiful flowers produce pollen and eggs, how pollination works, and the magic of double fertilization.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: This is the process of forming pollen grains in the anther. Each pollen grain contains two cells: a larger vegetative cell (forms the pollen tube) and a smaller generative cell (divides to form two male gametes).

Inside the ovary's ovule, a single cell divides to form the female gametophyte (embryo sac). A mature embryo sac is 7-celled and 8-nucleate, containing an egg, synergids, antipodals, and polar nuclei.

The transfer of pollen to the stigma. It can be Autogamy (same flower), Geitonogamy (different flower, same plant), or Xenogamy (different plant, bringing genetic variation). Plants use wind, water, or animals as agents.

A unique feature of flowering plants! One male gamete fuses with the egg to form a Zygote (Syngamy). The second male gamete fuses with two polar nuclei to form the primary endosperm nucleus (Triple Fusion).
After fertilization, the petals fall off. The zygote develops into an embryo, the endosperm provides it with food, the ovules harden into Seeds, and the entire ovary swells up to become a Fruit!

fun_activity.title: 🌺 The Hibiscus Dissection
fun_activity.instructions: Take a large flower like a Hibiscus or Lily. Carefully remove the petals. Identify the yellow pollen-covered anthers (male). Cut open the swollen base (ovary) with a safe blade to see the tiny white dots inside—those are the ovules waiting to become seeds!

exam_tips: 📌 'Double Fertilization' is a guaranteed long-answer question. Clearly define both Syngamy and Triple Fusion, and state their products (Zygote and PEN).
📌 Know the difference between True fruits (develop only from the ovary, like mango) and False fruits (thalamus contributes to fruit formation, like apple).
📌 Memorize the structure of a mature anatropous ovule with a neat, labeled diagram.
quick_recap: ⭐ A mature embryo sac in angiosperms is uniquely 7-celled but 8-nucleate.
⭐ Water pollination is actually quite rare in flowering plants; most rely on insects like bees.
⭐ Apomixis is a special mechanism where plants produce seeds without fertilization (acting like asexual reproduction).
